Evidence E6 directly supports this claim, stating that "Automotive sales revenue increased $4.22 billion, or 27%, in the three months ended June 30, 2026 as compared to the three months ended June 30, 2025." This is a clear year-over-year increase in automotive revenues for Q2 2026. Evidence E2 provides additional corroboration by noting the corresponding increase in cost of automotive sales revenue due to increased deliveries year over year. The claim is fully supported by the evidence.
